TaskDescription: No task. Interictal segments of clinical long-term intracranial EEG monitoring (presurgical epilepsy diagnostics). Recordings of seizure activity and the three hours after the last seizure were excluded by the source.
InstitutionName: Department of Neurology, Inselspital, Bern University Hospital, University of Bern
iEEGPlacementScheme: Intracranial strip and depth electrodes placed for presurgical evaluation of pharmacoresistant temporal lobe epilepsy; x and y are neighbouring channels of the same class (focal or nonfocal). Electrode type (strip or depth) and position of each signal were not stored by the source.
iEEGReference: Re-referenced by the source against the median of all channels free of permanent artifacts (visual inspection). Original recording reference: extracranial electrode placed between 10-20 positions Fz and Pz.

ButterworthBandPass.Description: Applied by the source before release: digital band-pass 0.5-150 Hz, fourth-order Butterworth, forward and backward (zero-phase).

Downsampling.Description: Applied by the source: EEG signals were sampled at 512 or 1024 Hz depending on whether they were recorded with more or less than 64 channels; signals recorded at 1024 Hz were down-sampled to 512 Hz. Which pairs were down-sampled was not stored by the source.

SubjectArtefactDescription: Pairs with prominent measurement artifacts were discarded by the source after visual inspection; moderate 50 Hz power-line contamination was not an exclusion criterion.
